about: The epistola of the formulary “Saint Bartholomew the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: You are the body of Christ, and members of member. And God has indeed appointed some within the Church: first as apostles, second as prophets, third as teachers, then powers, after that graces of healings, assistance, guidance, kinds of tongues, interpretations of speech. Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all powers? Do all have the grace of healings? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret? But strive after the better gifts.
